overview.narrative:
REITs traded mixed Monday with a clear rotation into cyclical property types. Office led all sectors at +1.16% on average, powered by Hudson Pacific's +6.84% surge—likely tied to renewed West Coast leasing momentum—while Kilroy added +2.63%. Retail (+0.83%) and Hospitality (+0.81%) also posted solid gains, with Macerich up +1.89% and Summit Hotel +5.01%. On the other side, Towers were the clear laggard at -2.13%, with Crown Castle down -3.36%, as rising rate expectations continued pressuring long-duration names. Net Lease fell -0.53%, consistent with that theme.

The most notable divergence sits within Healthcare, where the sector averaged a flat +0.04% but masked a 600bp spread between CareTrust REIT (+2.11%) and Alexandria (-3.88%). ARE's selloff signals continued skepticism around life science demand fundamentals, while skilled nursing exposure found buyers. Cold storage name Americold (-4.44%) was the session's biggest loser, suggesting possible earnings pre-positioning or demand concerns weighing on specialty industrial.

Positioning into Tuesday should favor the Office/Retail momentum trade while staying cautious on Towers and long-duration Net Lease until rate sentiment stabilizes. Watch for follow-through on HPP—a second day of strength would confirm the move is institutional, not just short-covering. ARE bears remain in control near-term.
